reports.title: RLJ Lodging Trust Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is updating its full-year outlook to incorporate its third quarter outperformance and improved outlook for the fourth quarter. Comparable RevPAR and Hotel EBITDA outlooks exclude the seven Chicago Midway assets sold subsequent to the third quarter.

Comparable RevPAR Growth | +5.75% to +6.25%
Comparable Hotel EBITDA | $377M to $383M
Adjusted EBITDA | $352M to $358M
Adjusted FFO per diluted share | $1.47 to $1.51
